segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I know we had 30 minutes, so I wanted to confirm the seat count and the timing for the support analytics rollout.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that works. We’re looking at 42 seats to start, mostly support managers and team leads. If the pilot goes well, we may add another 15 in Q2.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 42 initial seats. And the go-live date you mentioned last week was February 12, is that still the target?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes. We’d like the system configured by February 5 so our team can do a week of testing before go-live.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That’s reasonable. Implementation for that scope is usually two weeks. We’d schedule kickoff for January 22, then configuration and training before February 5.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. On pricing, the quote had $31,920 for the year. Does that include onboarding?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, that includes the 42 annual seats and the standard onboarding package. The only separate line item is optional admin training, which was $1,800, but I left that out of the total for now.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. We probably don’t need the extra training. Our ops lead is comfortable handling admin setup after the first session.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. Contract term would be 12 months starting February 1, with invoicing annually upfront. Net 30 payment terms. Any issue with that?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, annual upfront is fine. Just make sure the invoice references purchase order 44817 and the billing contact is AP at our Denver office.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send the final order form today with the PO reference and the February 1 start date. If you can return it by Friday, we’ll hold the January 22 kickoff slot.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Send it over and I’ll route it for signature this afternoon.
